row:
We rescue cats from the streets in Romania, Carei and surrounding towns. We spay/neuter them and try to find them a forever home with responsible and loving owners.
A bit about us, we are a brother and sister that have had cats since we were little, and 3 years ago we started to rescue  abandoned cats from our city and from neighboring villages. We spay/neuter all our cats and many more too, over +200 cats and +30 dogs in the last 3 years, all from our own money but right now we've reached a point where it's impossible for us to help these animals from what we earn, that's why we've started this non-profit organization. We mostly need help with cat food as right now we have 188 cats, some very sick, some with dietary restrictions. We also cook for them but the food that we buy we try to get the best quality as medicine and treatments for the sick cost much more then good food that would prevent them from getting ill. Any help with cat food or small donations would be very welcome.
